[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Wanatte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]][[Halmad/Legends|Halmad]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Before he passed out the last time, Lieutenant Cothron said the captain had found some companionship for the evening.|Face Loran about Wanatte|<ref name="IF" />|}}
Captain Wanatte was a short [[Human/Legends|man]] with a craggy face enough for small snubfighters to fly the [[Trench Run Defense]] across. Wanatte was out drinking with other pilots at [[Rojio's]] one night when [[Wraith Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Kell Tainer]] and [[Ton Phanan]] provoked a fight with their group. The bar's [[Unidentified bartender (Rojio's)|bartender]] called the planet's military police and when they finally arrived, Wanatte and Tainer were the only two who remained conscious and still fighting. The [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] arrested all of them and on a deserted area, shot and stunned the Imperial pilots. The stormtroopers were actually the rest of the Wraith's in disguise, led by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]]. They took all of the stunned pilots back to [[Victory Base]]; while Wanatte was stashed inside a [[Skimmer/Legends|skimmer]] guarded by another Wraith, [[Voort saBinring]].<ref name="IF" />

After completing the final part of their [[Halmad campaign|mission]], which was infiltrate the base and steal its complement of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. Wanatte was still unconscious when the Wraiths returned to the skimmer. It is not known whether he was eventually killed by the Wraiths before leaving the planet.<ref name="IF" />
